name: prismalens-monorepo
description: Open-source AI-powered incident analysis and root cause detection

//overrides.e2b: GHSA-4cwx-7wf7-3272 + 4 more (undici < 8.9.0). e2b declares its cloud-sandbox HTTP client as an EXACT aliased optional peer (`undici8: npm:undici@8.8.0`), so no semver range admits the patch — only a newer e2b does. e2b 2.38.2 moves that alias to undici@8.10.0. This is a real parent bump, expressed as an override floor because `pnpm update` does not re-resolve an optional peerDependency whose specifier is `*` (see @prismalens/engine peerDependencies). REMOVE once pnpm re-resolves the `*` peer on its own, or once engine pins e2b >= 2.38.2 directly.
//overrides.js-yaml@5: GHSA-pm4m-ph32-ghv5 (js-yaml 5.0.0-5.2.1, exponential parse time in flow collections). @nestjs/swagger 11.4.6 — the latest release — pins `js-yaml: 5.2.1` EXACTLY, so no parent bump reaches the patch. Scoped to the 5.x line on purpose: js-yaml 3.x (read-yaml-file) and 4.x (cosmiconfig, xmlbuilder2, @changesets/parse) are patched by plain resolution and must NOT be dragged to 5.x. REMOVE once @nestjs/swagger > 11.4.6 pins js-yaml >= 5.2.2.
//overrides.esbuild: GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr (esbuild 0.27.3-0.28.0, dev-server arbitrary file read on Windows). tsup 8.5.1 — the latest release — declares `esbuild: ^0.27.0`, which excludes every patched version; vite 8.2.1 already admits ^0.28.0 and 0.28.1 is independently in the tree via tsx/webpack/unplugin, so this override merely unifies the tree on the patched major-minor. REMOVE once tsup > 8.5.1 declares esbuild ^0.28.0.
